declarations.prior_family_row: | L1 F: SocialRelation, WorkRelation | What observed connection organizes these participants' social/work arrangement? Abstract relationship roots: SocialRelation leaves both axes open; WorkRelation specifies structural nature and leaves orientation open. Endpoints Agent→Agent; neither root is directly executable. Employment fills directed orientation. | OSTROM and ILO19/ICSE18; root/Society. New generalization of `sociology-c08–c11` and owner employment direction. Actor–resource relations need another endpoint signature, not forced inheritance. | Existing durable worker/employer arrangement qualifies as a structural candidate. Two CSV rows sharing an ID do not establish a social relation. A reciprocal relationship is not automatically a bond, and omission does not default to direction. |
declarations.status_rationale: Experimental research with recorded open issues; no new semantic/expert review or formal controversy assessment. Exact syntax evidence is separate from conservative annotation technical_validation.

declarations.prior_family_row: | L2 F: Work, Worker | Which activities produce goods/services for others or own use? Dependent Work process native to HumanIndividual; Worker contextual role applies to person. Work specializes physical:Activity; no mandatory decision or paid-employment restriction. | ILO19 §§6–12; Society/physical. Adds missing general roots before economics employee specialization. | Subsistence food preparation and unpaid care for others can be work while outside paid employment. Sleeping/self-care alone is not work under this pinned definition. A volunteer remains outside EmployeeOf unless another arrangement establishes it. Multiple forms can coexist for a person. |
declarations.status_rationale: Experimental research with recorded open issues; no new semantic/expert review or formal controversy assessment. Exact syntax evidence is separate from conservative annotation technical_validation.

declarations.prior_family_row: | L3 F: InstitutionalArrangement, RuleAdoption | Which recognized rules govern an irrigation association, and when was a rule adopted? Abstract thing candidate identifies the rule arrangement; bounded event recognizes adoption by authorized participants. Participants/rule/version are occurrence support, not extra binary endpoints. | OSTROM, ILO154; Society/Agency. Refines `sociology-c05/c13`; Institution ambiguity already in `society-c03` and October decisions. | A collective rule persists while officeholders change; adoption can occur in a meeting. A copied rule document or every meeting is not an adoption, and the association is not identical to its rules. A detected institutional pattern is the open competing Configuration head, never model-each. |
declarations.status_rationale: Experimental research with recorded open issues; no new semantic/expert review or formal controversy assessment. Exact syntax evidence is separate from conservative annotation technical_validation.

declarations.prior_family_row: | L6 U: AuthorizedRepresentativeOf | Whom may this agent represent, in this setting? Membership or meeting attendance alone does not confer a mandate; representation does not prove the representative controlled the outcome. |
